hero.title: Learn to surf and cook with Diego on the beach
hero.tagline: In the morning we surf the first waves. In the afternoon we cook ceviche from today's catch. In the evening we sit on the beach, eat together and have a Pisco Sour while the sun goes down. A day with Diego you will not forget.
hero.metaDescription: Learn to surf and cook Peruvian food in one day, with Diego in Lobitos, northern Peru. Small groups, gear included, dinner on the beach.
hero.imageAlt: Diego cutting ceviche at a wooden table on the beach, surfers behind him in the evening light

intro.heading: Surf and cook in one day
intro.body: You can take a surf lesson anywhere. Here you walk down to the boats with Diego afterwards, pick the fish and cook it yourself. By the end you can do both: catch a wave and make a ceviche.

surf.title: Surf with Diego
surf.body: Two hours in the water, four people at most. That way everyone gets enough time. Board and wetsuit are included.

cook.title: Cook it yourself
cook.body: Lime, chilli, red onion and fresh fish. Diego shows you every step. The cooking is yours.
cook.imageAlt: Hands preparing ceviche on a wooden table

eat.title: Eat together
eat.body: One long table on the beach, all of it cooked by you. With a Pisco Sour and the sunset.
eat.imageAlt: Guests at a long table at sunset

groups.title: Small groups
groups.body: Four people a day at most. That way Diego has time for you.

gear.title: Board and wetsuit
gear.body: Included. The water is cooler than you would think, but you do not need to bring anything.

photos.title: Free photos
photos.body: Someone photographs you while you surf. You get the pictures afterwards, at no charge.

food.title: Food and ingredients
food.body: Everything you cook and drink is part of the price.

place.heading: 300 metre waves, hardly anyone in the water
place.body: Lobitos lies in the north of Peru, where the desert meets the sea. It used to be a British oil town and the old wooden houses are still standing. Today it is mostly surfers who live here. No resort, no promenade, no queue in the water.

kitchenTeaser.heading: Straight off the boat
kitchenTeaser.body: Peruvian cooking means fish, lime and chilli. It does not need more than that. Diego shows you how it works.

closing.heading: Only four places a day
closing.body: Write to us with when you want to come and how many of you there are. Diego answers within a day or two, and tells you whether there is still a room free.

hero.title: Surf
hero.tagline: In Lobitos the waves break to the left, long and even. Perfect for learning.

beginner.title: Beginner
beginner.body: We start in shallow water, where the wave has already broken. Paddling, position, standing up. Most people are up on the first day.

intermediate.title: You can stand already
intermediate.body: You get to your feet, but the wave decides where you go. We practise reading the wave and paddling in at the right angle.

advanced.title: You surf confidently
advanced.body: Then you do not need a lesson, you need someone who knows the spots. Diego surfs with you and gives you tips.

season.title: When should I come?
season.body: Lobitos works all year. From April to October the waves are bigger. From December to March it is warmer and easier for learning.

water.title: Is the water cold?
water.body: Cooler than you would think. A short wetsuit is usually enough, a long one in winter. Both are included.

safety.title: Is it safe?
safety.body: You are never alone in the water. We surf in small groups, run a short briefing beforehand, and pick the spot to match your level.

imageAlts.wave: Surfer riding along an open face

hero.title: Kitchen
hero.tagline: Raw fish in lime, with chilli and sweet potato. That is how the coast of Peru eats.

intro.heading: We cook what the boats bring in
intro.body: In the morning we go down to the boats and see what there is. Then we plan the afternoon. That is exactly why it tastes so fresh. The dishes below are the usual ones, but we cannot promise them.

ceviche.name: Ceviche clásico
ceviche.note: Fish, lime, red onion, chilli, sweet potato

tiradito.name: Tiradito de ají amarillo
tiradito.note: Thinly sliced fish, yellow chilli sauce

causa.name: Causa limeña
causa.note: Cold potato with lime, chilli and avocado

conchas.name: Conchas a la parmesana
conchas.note: Scallops with butter and cheese, briefly grilled

kitchen.diet: Vegetarian and vegan work for nearly everything. Just tell us beforehand and we shop accordingly.

hero.title: Stay
hero.tagline: Simple rooms, right on the beach.

intro.heading: You sleep right by the sea
intro.body: Lobitos was built twice. First by an oil company a hundred years ago, then by surfers who built with whatever was around. The rooms are simple and the wifi is slow. In return you hear how big the waves are in the morning, before you get up.

stay.note: There are only a few rooms. Just ask us and we will tell you what is free. Or we point you to neighbours we would stay with ourselves.

about.body1: Diego grew up on this coast and spends his life between the water and the kitchen. He teaches calmly and without rushing: little talking, plenty of time in the water.
about.body2: The cooking came along by itself. Guests stayed for dinner and asked how it was done. Today the afternoon in the kitchen is the main reason many people come.
